summary: Validated EquineSync invite/onboarding expansion end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 new tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_invites_and_analytics.py covering: POST /api/invites (dev_accept_url surfacing in dev mode, role-guard 403 for groom, 409 on dup email & on existing user), GET /api/invites (token_hash not leaked), resend (new dev_accept_url + sends history grows), revoke, verify (404 invalid / 410 used), accept (creates user, JWT, auto_launch=true for barn_manager / false for groom, pre-creates onboarding_progress), POST /api/onboarding/reset (re-opens wizard), tenant-reset (admin-only, requires confirm='RESET', onboarding & all_setup_data scopes, unknown scope 400, groom 403), POST /api/events + GET /api/events/onboarding-funnel (admin-only), PATCH /api/onboarding/progress data deep-merge (sibling keys preserved). Frontend: login admin -> dashboard 'setup-checklist-card' renders with all 10 status tiles + resume-setup; clicking 'checklist-barn' navigates to /onboarding. Onboarding Locations 'Type' is now a shadcn Select (combobox role, 7 options, selectable). Staff step invite -> dev-link-banner appears with accept-invite token URL + Copy button. Settings page exposes reopen-setup + tenant-reset-onboarding + tenant-reset-all to admin. /accept-invite?token=... renders accept-form; submitting password creates user and redirects barn_manager to /onboarding with welcome toast (auto_launch_onboarding=true working).

minor.issue: APP_BASE_URL env var defaults to hardcoded 'https://herd-hub-19.emergent.host' when unset. In preview environments the frontend is on a different host (herd-hub-19.preview.emergentagent.com), so dev_accept_url shown in the UI points at the wrong origin. Recommend deriving base_url from request origin or documenting APP_BASE_URL must be set per env.

Wipes 'staff_invites' + 'invites' + 'barn' + 'locations' + 'feed_templates' + 'inventory' + 'recurring_schedules' + 'onboarding_progress' but does NOT wipe horses/owners/riders created during onboarding. Either rename scope (e.g. 'setup_collections') or extend cleanup to match what users committed via CSV.

Body uses `body.password` directly without checking against a confirm field; relies on frontend to enforce match. Acceptable, but document. Also, password complexity rule is only length>=8 — no character class enforcement.

Resets the CURRENT user only (correct), but TenantReset(scope='onboarding') wipes ALL users' progress — semantics are clear but consider renaming endpoint to /admin/tenant-reset/onboarding to avoid confusion with /onboarding/reset.

action_items: (Minor) Make APP_BASE_URL default to request origin (or env-driven per environment) so dev_accept_url matches the frontend host in preview/staging.
(Minor) Consider extending tenant-reset 'all_setup_data' scope to include horses/owners/riders, or rename the scope to clarify it only wipes config collections.
(Nit) Add password complexity hint on AcceptInvite form (currently silent minLength=8).
(Nit) Differentiate naming between user-scoped /onboarding/reset and tenant-wide /admin/tenant-reset to reduce confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: Deep-merge implementation _deep_merge() is correct and recursive — verified by sibling-key preservation test (PASS).
Invite tokens are stored as sha256(token_hash) and never returned in API responses — good security.
auto_launch_onboarding correctly derived from role ∈ {admin, barn_manager}; onboarding_progress doc pre-created with correct shape (steps map, current_step, completed=false for setup roles).
_track() uses fire-and-forget try/except — good, never fails the parent request.
require_setup_role enforced on /invites POST, /invites/{id}/resend, /invites/{id}/revoke, GET /invites, GET /events/onboarding-funnel; tenant-reset is admin-only — role guards consistent.
Mailer dev mode (RESEND_API_KEY blank) returns {status: 'dev_logged', dev: true}; server then attaches dev_accept_url to invite response only when mail.get('dev') is truthy — clean abstraction.
InviteAccept does NOT support inviting an existing user by re-sending a token, but POST /invites already 409s on existing email — symmetric behavior.
Tenant-reset 'all_setup_data' deletes the 'barn' collection entirely; on next /api/barn GET the seeded primary barn must be re-bootstrapped — verify seed re-runs or expose a fix-up endpoint.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: login, checklist, onboarding, shadcn Select, staff invite, dev banner, settings controls, accept-invite redirect)

seed_data_creation: Test created multiple invite docs with TEST_/e2e_ prefixed emails — some accepted users now exist in db.users (e2e_acc_*, test_invite_*); these do not pollute UI lists. test_onboarding_scope tenant-reset wipes onboarding_progress; subsequent admin GET /onboarding/progress recreates a fresh doc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review_request features verified working. After test_onboarding_scope runs, admin's onboarding_progress is wiped; first subsequent GET /onboarding/progress re-creates a fresh pending doc (verified). APP_BASE_URL hardcoded fallback is the only environmental quirk — testing on preview hosts requires rewriting the host portion of dev_accept_url to the preview origin before navigating (script in iteration 3 does this).
